primary_interest.quote: Before we get into the voice demo, can I jump in with the thing I actually care about most? Inference.

use_case.quote: we're building an internal copilot for our staff. It lives in our own application, our own pipeline.

inference_framing.quote: I don't need it tied to any voice agent. I want to buy the hosted LLM API by itself.

inference_raised_by.quote: can I jump in with the thing I actually care about most? Inference.

competitors_inference.quote: We've been looking at Together AI, and honestly I want to know if you're a real alternative.

competitors_voice.quote: we use Twilio today for telephony.

decision_criteria.quote: Together AI quoted us about seventy-one cents per million tokens. Our volume is around four thousand million tokens a month, so small differences matter.

stated_reason.quote: Our target is time to first token under five hundred milliseconds. Staff will abandon a copilot that feels sluggish.
